Definition: from G2596 and G2186; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault):--make insurrection against.
BiblicalUsage: The Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul and brought him to the judgment seat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the judgment seat was where Paul's accusers thought they had him, and it became his pulpit instead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
